# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow [`docs/core-friction-points.md`](../docs/core-friction-points.md) before any feature or code change. If the change does not reduce one of the three friction points (game setup divergence, the two-pass coding slog, or post-match clip assembly), do not implement it.

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the product gate, personas, user journeys, and push-back rules, and [`docs/design-language.md`](../docs/design-language.md) for UI tokens, semantic classes, and layout rules.
